scope.experience: Ordinary text chat for questions, brainstorming and writing
scope.task: Explain a concept, draft a short email, then revise it through follow-up prompts.
scope.configuration: Standard web chat; no connected apps or agentic execution. No specific paid model or plan was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual using the ordinary chat experience

conversational.rationale: Natural-language dialogue supports open-ended requests and contextual follow-ups without a fixed task sequence.
conversational.uncertainty: The assessment describes the interaction format, not whether every dialogue succeeds.

specialization.rationale: The same assistant covers explanations, writing, translation and many unrelated topics; the selected email task does not make it domain-specific.
specialization.uncertainty: Custom GPTs and specialized agent experiences would need separate profiles.

autonomy.rationale: The scoped chat produces answers or drafts in response to user prompts; the user chooses follow-ups and any external use of the result.
autonomy.uncertainty: This score excludes tools that can execute code, operate apps or continue scheduled work.

accessibility.rationale: Conversational input and general-purpose tasks suit a broad non-specialist audience through familiar web/mobile experiences.
accessibility.uncertainty: Account, language, regional availability and usage limits vary; no assistive-technology or usability testing was conducted.

explainability.rationale: Users see their prompts and responses and can ask for clarification, but ordinary ungrounded chat does not consistently expose verifiable evidence for claims.
explainability.uncertainty: A generated explanation is not proof of faithful model reasoning; cited search responses are outside this scope.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: standard ChatGPT text chat without Work, Codex, search agents or external actions. Scores are design estimates. Official source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9260256-chatgpt-capabilities-overview .
